blocks.text: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *žiti (compare Belarusian жыць, Ukrainian жи́ти, Old Church Slavonic жити), from Proto-Indo-European *gʷeih₃w- (“to live”). Cognate to Lithuanian gyventi, Sanskrit जीवति (“lives”), Latin vīvō, and English quick.
